errors.text_span: stellt den prozentualen Anteil der Erwerbsbevölkerung im Alter von 20 bis 64 Jahren für Österreich und Deutschland dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the chart shows the percentage of the working-age population. Based on the figure's caption ('Sinkender Anteil Beamter in Österreich' - Decreasing share of civil servants in Austria), the chart actually shows the share of civil servants as a percentage of the working-age population. The description omits the crucial subject (civil servants).

errors.text_span: bleibt bis etwa 2010 relativ stabil bei etwa 3,6-3,7 %
errors.evidence: This description of the blue line (Germany) is inaccurate. The line is not stable; it rises from approx. 3.6% in 2000 to a peak of nearly 3.9% around 2009 before declining. The stated range of 3.6-3.7% is incorrect for the period from 2005 to 2010.
The prompt asks for a description of the line style ('Linienstil (z. B. durchgezogen, gestrichelt)'). The description fails to mention that both lines are solid ('durchgezogen').
